jobs.description:
As Store Manager, you hold full responsibility for results, team leadership, and brand representation. You lead by example and ensure every client interaction reflects the boutique's DNA of elegance, service, and performance.

This role operates in an international context and requires daily professional communication in both English and French. Fluency in both languages, spoken and written, is mandatory.

The boutique plays by four values:

🎾 Play as one team  You lead, coach, and develop your team to deliver a consistently high level of service. You create a strong team culture built on accountability, collaboration, and performance. 

🎾 Play with elegance  You embody the Lacoste brand in your appearance, communication, and way of working. From client experience to store presentation, attention to detail is second nature to you.

🎾 Play with audacity  You take ownership, identify opportunities, and proactively improve performance and processes. You are comfortable taking decisions and driving change where needed.

🎾 Play with tenacity You are results driven and KPI focused. You translate targets into concrete actions and follow through with discipline and consistency.
 
What they're looking for:

• Proven recent experience in a senior leadership role in retail within premium or luxury retail
• Fluent command of English and French, both spoken and written, is mandatory
• Flexibility to work weekends, evenings, and public holidays when required
• Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and retain high performing teams
• Strong commercial and analytical mindset with clear ownership of results
• Ability to operate at management level within an international retail organisation 
What they offer:

• Full-time undetermined contract after a 3 month contract 
• A key leadership role in one of the boutique's strategic Brussels locations
• A dynamic and premium working environment within an iconic brand
• Professional development and training opportunities
• Competitive salary with performance based bonus
• Generous employee discount on their collections
Are you the Store Manager they are looking for?

We are looking for packing employees who can work in three shifts and would like to work in the food industry in Dendermonde.

You will work in the packing department of a company that specializes in packing frozen products. You will work in a refrigerated environment (around 10 degrees Celsius).

• Checking the quality of products

• Packing all kinds of products (e.g. fish, snacks, vegetables, ...) in boxes or bags

• Sticking labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Close communication with the operator

• ...

• You have previous experience in a production environment and can work flexible in three shifts.

• You do not mind performing physical work at pace.

• You have a good knowledge of the Dutch or English language in case of safety instructions.

• As the company is located in an industrial zone, it is not accessible by public transport. You can travel each day independently to Dendermonde.

• You are looking for long-term employment and do not mind performing a 2h packing test after a positive job interview.

As part of the ASP service within the IT department, client is looking for a Software Asset Management Officer to ensure reliable, compliant, and optimized management of the IT software license portfolio.

The assignment combines administrative, analytical, and monitoring activities, with a strong focus on coordination between IT, Procurement, and Finance teams. The consultant will contribute to cost control, license compliance, and the continuous improvement of Software Asset Management processes.
Key responsibilities

• Manage the complete lifecycle of IT licenses: request, approval, acquisition, deployment, monitoring, and renewal

• Maintain an accurate, reliable, and up-to-date database of active, expired, renewable, and licenses to be retired

• Analyze contracts, terms of use, and license clauses in collaboration with IT, Procurement, and Finance teams

• Analyze software usage data to identify unused, underused, or oversized licenses

• Propose optimization actions to reduce costs and improve license utilization

• Establish and monitor key performance indicators covering active licenses, unused licenses, upcoming renewals, compliance risks, and potential savings

• Prepare analyses, reports, and dashboards to support management decision-making

• Provide administrative and analytical follow-up for Software Asset Management activities

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of SAM processes and data quality

Ideal candidate

The ideal candidate has solid experience in Software Asset Management or IT Asset Management, combined with strong administrative, analytical, and license-management skills.

They are able to work independently, analyze complex data, identify optimization opportunities, and communicate effectively with various internal and external stakeholders.

Mandatory skills

• Minimum 3 years of experience in a role related to:

• Software Asset Management

• IT License Management

• IT Asset Management

• IT Procurement

• or a similar function

• Good knowledge of software licensing models from major software vendors

• Experience analyzing and monitoring software contracts and licensing terms

• Strong ability to analyze software usage data

• Good knowledge of at least one analytical tool such as advanced Excel, SQL, or Power BI

• Ability to prepare analyses, reports, and dashboards

• French or Dutch with fluent English

• Strong administrative rigor and ability to manage multiple cases efficiently

• Autonomous, proactive, and ownership-driven mindset

 

Strong assets

• Experience with SAM/ITAM solutions

• Strong knowledge of SQL and/or Power BI

• Experience with software cost optimization and renewal management

• Experience working in a complex IT or large-enterprise environment

• Experience collaborating with IT, Procurement, and Finance teams

Professional & soft skills

• Excellent analytical skills

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

• Autonomous and responsible

• Proactive with a strong sense of initiative

• Strong ownership and accountability

• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills

• Ability to work cross-functionally with IT, Procurement, and Finance teams

• Results-oriented and focused on continuous improvement

• Critical thinking and solution-oriented approach
